status: post-opening held-out community-stability hypothesis frozen before validation readback
ecological_question: Does local response diversity among frog species buffer active-community richness against rainfall contrast through compensatory species responses?

trait_period_species_response.pairing: within State x RouteNumber x RunNumber, adjacent observed years, lower DaysSinceRain oriented wetter
trait_period_species_response.species_event: y=1 for wet-only and y=0 for dry-only occurrences
trait_period_species_response.model: binomial-logit y ~ centered rain_contrast + centered temp_difference + centered doy_difference + centered year_gap with route-clustered covariance

local_pool.definition: union of species acoustically active in eligible 2001-2007 runs for the same State x RouteNumber x RunNumber stratum
local_pool.scored_species: intersection with species having estimable early-period response scores

primary_predictor.name: response_sign_diversity
primary_predictor.definition: 4*p*(1-p), where p is the fraction of scored early-pool species with positive early wet-vs-dry log odds
primary_predictor.interpretation: 0 = all scored species respond in the same direction; 1 = equal mixture of positive and negative response signs
primary_predictor.rationale: Temporal validation previously showed stronger sign concordance than rank repeatability, so the new test uses only response direction, not post hoc rank information.

validation_pairs.construction: same matched-pair rule, with no pair crossing the temporal split

primary_model.formula: richness_gain ~ rain_contrast * response_sign_diversity + rain_contrast * mean_early_response + rain_contrast * z_log_early_scored_richness + temp_difference + doy_difference + year_gap + C(State) + C(RunNumber)

secondary_diagnostics: replace sign diversity with SD of early adjusted species log odds; descriptive only
late pair compensation fraction = 1 - abs(wet_only-dry_only)/(wet_only+dry_only) for discordant>0; test response_sign_diversity main and rain interaction descriptively
report coverage, early scored richness, mean early response, and correlation among moderators
interpretation_if_supported: Communities containing species with opposing rainfall-response directions show weaker net richness shifts under rainfall contrast, consistent with response-diversity buffering of the behaviourally realized active community.
boundaries: Response diversity is estimated from acoustic activity, not demographic response.
Temporal holdout reduces but does not eliminate confounding by persistent route characteristics.
No rainfall causality, occupancy, abundance, colonization, extinction, or demographic stability claim.
This analysis is post-opening but its predictor, sample gate, formula, and direction are frozen before validation readback.
No alternative time split, response-diversity formula, or minimum coverage rule may be substituted after readback.
